scenes.title: Regulation Powder — Night Woods Snowball Fight (candidate insert)
scenes.description: EXT. WOODS BEHIND THE BUILDING — THE FURNITURE CLEARING — NIGHT. Rubella and Lillith fight a seven-beat snowball fight under formal match rules nobody wrote down: terms, a service offer, body-and-below, a match to eleven. The abandoned upright piano — lid off, action open to the sky — is the scoreboard; every ball that lands on the strings is the entire score. Lillith has nine pre-built snowballs hidden in the bathing cabinet. Rubella turns her back to harvest the piano lid and is not thrown at. One ball has slab ice in it, lands, does not break, and draws a thin red line; nobody apologizes and the match gets slower instead of faster. At nine-all a bad throw hits a loaded pine bough and buries Lillith standing. The count is disputed, traded for the cabinet complaint, and abandoned at nine-all. Mostly choreography — the dialog is the paperwork. Parked at order 99 as an Episode 2 candidate insert off the Studio Huddle spine; it belongs to Ep2's night-furniture motif (bathing cabinet, piano). Full blocking, ammo continuity, written silences and priority shots in notes/scenes/regulation-powder.md.
